title: This War of Mine: The Board Game
subtitle: Gritty Civilian Survival Board Game Campaign
tagline: Endure the harsh reality of civilian survival in a besieged city through desperate days and perilous nights.
loreSummary: In war, not everyone is a soldier. Trapped in the ruined city of Pogoren, you and your companions must scavenge for food, medicine, and fuel while confronting harrowing moral decisions in an unforgiving struggle to survive until the ceasefire.
keyFeatures: Faithful, gut-wrenching tabletop adaptation of 11 bit studios' acclaimed video game
Open-and-play journal system with over 1,900 branching narrative story scripts
Day-and-night cycle: barricade your tenement by day, scavenge ruined city streets by night
Persistent campaign save sheets tracking wounds, illness, misery, and psychological trauma

this_war_of_mine_ceasefire.name: Until the Ceasefire (Full Survival Campaign)
this_war_of_mine_ceasefire.description: The definitive 8-day survival ordeal, weathering cold, night raids, and resource shortages until peace arrives.

this_war_of_mine_first_snow.name: First Snow Survival (Short Survival Arc)
this_war_of_mine_first_snow.description: An introductory 4-day campaign arc focusing on early shelter defense and initial scavenging runs before the deep freeze.

this_war_of_mine_ironman.name: Winter Siege Hardcore (All Scripts & Harsh Events)
this_war_of_mine_ironman.description: An exhaustive extended 12-day endurance test facing severe blizzards, epidemic outbreaks, and heavy militia raids.

milestones.title: Securing the Shelter
milestones.description: Clearing rubble, boarding up breached windows, and building makeshift beds to survive the initial shellings.

milestones.title: First Night Scavenge
milestones.phase: Act II - Into the Silent Streets
milestones.description: Venturing out past sniper fire into the decrepit city pharmacy and supermarket to bring back food and bandages.

milestones.title: The Bitter Winter Frost
milestones.description: Freezing temperatures set in, forcing desperate choices between burning precious books and scavenging wood for the heater.

milestones.title: Desperate Strangers at the Door
milestones.description: Confronting night raids and moral crossroads when desperate neighbors and armed militia plead or demand entrance.

milestones.title: The Ceasefire Horn
milestones.description: Surviving until the peace accords are broadcast across Pogoren, tallying the human cost of endurance.
